revenue_model.description: The company generates revenue by selling raw materials, packaging materials, and supplies, and by providing transportation and shipping services. These are sold to customers in the food industry, retail, restaurant services, and other industries.
revenue_model.quote: Leipurin focuses on plant- and dairy-based raw materials, packaging materials and supplies. Customers include bakeries, other food industry, retail and restaurant services.

business_structure.description: Aspo Plc is a Finnish public corporation whose shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. The company operates through its continuing segments, ESL Shipping and Telko.
business_structure.quote: Aspo Plc is a Finnish public Corporation, and its shares are listed on Nasdaq Helsinki Ltd. The operating and reportable segments of Aspo Group’s continuing opera- tions are ESL Shipping, and Telko.
